name: Twig IntlExtension
description: Provides the Twig IntlExtension (twig/intl-extra) so Intl-based Twig functions work in templates.
project_description:
There's a known core issue when using Twig IntlExtension: [#3419294] 
 

 Provides the Twig IntlExtension (twig/intl-extra) in Drupal, so that Twig functions relying on it can be used in Twig templates.

 For example:

 
 format_currency 
 format_date 
 format_datetime 
 format_time 
 format_number 
 ... 
 
 (See https://github.com/twigphp/intl-extra for details)

 You need this module, when you plan to use one of these Twig functions that point out:

 This twig function is part of the IntlExtension which is not installed by default. Install it first: [...]

 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Simply install this module with its dependencies! No configuration needed,

 composer require drupal/twig_intl && drush en twig_intl 

Composer is needed to fetch the dependencies!

 Back to top 

 Alternatives: 
 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/twig_extensions 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/intl_date 
 
 Heavily inspired by the Twig Extensions module by @joelpittet - thank you!
